architecture_rubric.INSUFFICIENT: independent heuristic or smoothing of historical outputs with no match distribution
architecture_rubric.PARTIAL: coherent but built from a single rating (Elo) and iid-set assumption with no serve/return, game or fatigue state
architecture_rubric.SUFFICIENT: market output is derived from a coherent player/serve/return/format distribution and the market's physics is respected

base.confirmed_canonical: origin/main holds the only tennis system (foundation, serving builder, grader, six champion gates + reports, workflow step, API routes); no tennis branch or PR exists; 17 commits all on main

aces_df.note: oracle rows are postgame, descriptive attribution only
oracle_diagnostics: actual serve points x predicted rate
predicted serve points x actual rate

simple: elo_bucket_fit_mean (best_of x deciles of canonical blended Elo prob, DEV mean margin)
rank_logistic (one slope on log rank-points ratio, MLE on DEV)

set_score.human: winner prob from the human moneyline, conditional set-score split from DEV frequencies by (best_of, bucket of winner prob)
simple: winner_prob_x_conditional_split (incumbent winner prob, DEV conditional straight-sets share by best_of)

total_games.human: E[sets | q, best_of] x gps where q is the CANONICAL-order blended Elo match-win prob inverted to a per-set prob, E[sets] from the race distribution, and gps = 0.6 x DEV mean games-per-set by (tour, surface, bucket of |p-0.5|) + 0.4 x the mean of the two players' prior-10 games-per-set shrunk toward the DEV bucket value with k=5. No fitted model, no sportsbook line.
total_games.prior_k_definition: mean of the two players' average total games in their last k completed matches (matches the incumbent's two-player symmetry)
simple: surface_fit_mean (tour x surface x best_of mean from DEV)
bestof_fit_mean (tour x best_of mean from DEV)
elo_mismatch_fit_mean (best_of x |blended Elo prob - 0.5| bucket {<.10,.10-.20,.20-.30,>=.30} mean from DEV)

cause_flags_evidence_only: HEAVY_FAVORITE_BLOWOUT (favorite prob >=0.75 and actual total < prediction - 6)
ORDER_LEAKAGE_EXPOSED (a player's history contained a same-tournament later-round match)
catastrophic_misses.moneyline: favorite probability >= 0.85 and the favorite lost
catastrophic_misses.rule: flags are descriptive and fixed; no flag -> UNATTRIBUTED

BURNED_DIAGNOSTIC.use: gate HOLDOUT; consumed; Phase0 reports on it as retrospective evidence only

chronology.CLEAN_FORWARD: forecasts created after a V2 engine lock is pushed; none exist

DEV.use: Elo warm-up in every incumbent gate; Phase0 baseline constants may be estimated here only

EXPOSED.reason: production forward picks since 2026-09-09 and bug-fix decisions made on live results (commits 8d8e6ba 2026-09-24, a3c8900 2026-09-27); not read

SEALED_UNTOUCHED.rule: proved untouched by phase0_chronology_audit.json (no gate, serving, audit or debugging evaluation uses it); NOT read by Phase0; reserved for Phase1 single-pass confirmation

SELECTION.use: gate VAL; consumed by gate decisions; any Phase0 constant choice from a preregistered grid is made here once

chronology.evidence_grade: RETROSPECTIVE_BURNED for every Phase0 number (VAL and HOLDOUT were consumed by incumbent gate decisions)

commit_order: this protocol and source_manifest.json (before any result)

data.schema_used: parse_matches_csv from tennis_player_matches_foundation_a.py is imported unchanged so the audit reproduces the production database rows for 2015-2024
data.sealed_2025: no 2025 or 2026 file is downloaded or read by Phase0 code (a test enforces the season cap). One structural probe (row count and max tourney_date only, no outcomes) was taken BEFORE this protocol to detect upstream staleness; it is disclosed here and read no result.
data.source_manifest: source_manifest.json (sha256 per file; fetched at run time, hash-verified, fail closed; raw CSVs are not redistributed)
data.tour_scope_note: TML ATP files contain tour-level main-draw (levels 250/500/M/G/F/A/D/O) with no Challenger and no qualifying rounds; WTA files contain tour-level plus ITF-level 'I' rows. Challenger coverage is quantified as ABSENT, not added.

forward_ledger_requirements.audit_of_incumbent: static review of the pick log and builder
v2_design: decision key (match id, scheduled start, horizon)
science receipt without any sportsbook fields; execution data in a separate downstream record

identity_audit.limits: ESPN data is not retrieved; unmatched live players are not in the pick log
identity_audit.scope: (a) historical TML identity quality: names shared by several ids, ids with several names, diacritic collisions; (b) the live resolver (exact normalized match, then unique-surname fallback) replayed against the logged picks' ESPN names; the surname fallback is classified a GUESS and counted separately. Predictions for ambiguous identities must not exist in V2.

markets.GAMES_SPREAD: games won by lexicographic P1 minus P2
markets.MONEYLINE: P(first-listed lexicographic player wins); target winner; incumbent: Elo overall+surface blend
markets.SET_SCORE: exact set score classes (winner side x sets lost); incumbent: Elo -> per-set prob -> iid race distribution
markets.TOTAL_GAMES: sum of games over completed sets; incumbent: mean of two players' recency-weighted games-per-set x expected sets

metrics.uncertainty: paired bootstrap on matches, 2000 resamples, seed 20261008, 95% percentile interval of mean paired difference; matches resampled whole (one prediction per match)

native_verdict_rules.BLOCKED_DATA: required comparator or label cannot be computed
native_verdict_rules.REJECTED: worse than the strongest simple baseline with the interval entirely above 0, or ECE_10bin >0.05
native_verdict_rules.SURVIVES: error metric better than the strongest SIMPLE baseline by >=2.0% relative with 95% bootstrap interval of the paired difference entirely below 0; for probability markets additionally ECE_10bin <=0.03
native_verdict_rules.WEAK: not worse than the strongest simple baseline (interval upper bound >=0) but not meeting SURVIVES
native_verdict_rules.evaluated_on: VAL 2020-2022 and HOLDOUT 2023-2024 separately; market verdict is the WORSE of the two; ATP and WTA separately; identical rows
native_verdict_rules.human_baseline: reported and compared but not used to define SURVIVES; the incumbent being worse than the human baseline with interval above 0 downgrades SURVIVES to WEAK
native_verdict_rules.strongest_simple_baseline: the simple baseline with the best metric on the same identical rows and period (conservative against the incumbent)

no_simulation_built: Phase0 builds no Monte Carlo and no match simulator; exact closed forms only. The incumbent's own normal/binomial simulations are audited, not extended.

ordering_rule.as_implemented_order: the incumbent gates and serving builder sort by (match_date, match_id) with match_id a TEXT key 'tour_tourneyid_matchnum', i.e. lexicographic match_num; this is audited as a possible look-ahead (later rounds processed before earlier rounds of the same tournament)
ordering_rule.canonical_order: (tourney_date, round_rank, int(match_num)) with round_rank R128<R64<R32<R16<QF<SF<F; round-robin/other rounds by int(match_num) inside the tournament date
ordering_rule.inversion_metric: within-tournament match pairs whose processing order contradicts round order, as a fraction of all within-tournament pairs, by tour
ordering_rule.reporting: incumbent replicas are reproduced AS_IMPLEMENTED (must match committed gate reports) and also in CANONICAL order; the difference is the order-leakage effect. All baselines and human baselines use CANONICAL order only.

populations.COMPLETED: is_incomplete == 0 (no RET/W/O/WEA/DEF/ABD/ABN marker) with a parseable score
populations.ELIGIBLE_per_market: the incumbent's own eligibility (total_games/games_spread/aces/DF: both players >=10 prior completed matches with known surface; moneyline/set score: both players >=5 prior matches; surface known)
populations.headline: HOLDOUT 2023-2024 and VAL 2020-2022 reported separately per tour
populations.identical_rows: every comparison between forecasts uses exactly the matches for which all compared forecasts exist; ATP and WTA are never pooled

retirement_rules.W/O: never played; excluded from every ledger
retirement_rules.reporting: marker counts by tour/season, share with serve stats, and the metric difference between RAW and CLEAN for moneyline
retirement_rules.science: truncated retired matches are not ordinary performances: excluded from game-length, spread, set-score and serve/return performance modelling and from performance labels; their winner is kept for rating updates (as the incumbent does) and reported separately
retirement_rules.settlement: sportsbook settlement of retirements is a separate downstream rule, never inferred here; evaluation ledgers: RAW (every decided match including RET, W/O excluded) and CLEAN (COMPLETED only); losing bets are never deleted because a player retired

checks: return points won derivable from the opponent row
out-of-time predictability of a player's serve-point-win rate from own history and opponent return history (HOLDOUT R^2 vs tour mean)
closed-form consistency of hold probability implied by serve-point-win vs observed holds

labels.DATA_SUFFICIENT: coverage >=0.90 of COMPLETED matches, identity violation rate <=0.01, out-of-time R^2 improvement over the tour mean >=0.02 on HOLDOUT

sportsbook_firewall.incumbent_note: the production total_games builder fetches a real totals line only to compute P(over) by a normal approximation around an already-computed projection; the projection itself does not read the line. Audited and documented, not changed.
sportsbook_firewall.rule: No sportsbook line, odds, implied probability, bookmaker, market consensus or price may be an input, target, selector, eligibility filter or tuning signal of any V2 science code. MODEL SCIENCE (player state, surface, format, serve/return, projections) is separated from EXECUTION (live line, price, book) which may only appear in a downstream record.

standard: independent tennis match outcome engine: PLAYER STATE + SURFACE/TOURNAMENT + SERVE + RETURN + FORMAT + INTERACTION -> point/service-game mechanics -> set distribution -> match distribution -> derived outcomes. Sportsbook inputs are downstream execution only. Phase0 builds nothing; it audits, reproduces, benchmarks and decides which market deserves Phase1.

surface_audit.scope: classification of every logged pick's tournament by replaying resolve_surface against TML names for 2015-2024; the surface_confirmed flag conflates exact and inferred
